As a returning shopper, I want to reuse a saved card, so that repeat purchases take less time.

## Outcome

Returning shoppers complete payment in under thirty seconds.

## Constraints

- Saved cards are visible only to their owner.

## Out of Scope

- Multiple saved cards: not planned.
